items.title: OEA Game Engine + OEA Games (Runner, Arena, Chess), Wi-Fi/WebRTC multiplayer, island game activities; launcher fixes
items.body:
## OEA Game Engine and OEA Games

A complete game engine inside the launcher, three games built on it, and a Games hub. New modules: `oea-engine` (engine, no launcher dependency) and `oea-games` (games written only against the engine's public API). Guide: `docs/oea-game-engine.md`.

**Engine**
- OpenGL ES 3 renderer: automatic instancing, frustum culling, sun shadow maps, procedural sky, linear lighting with ACES tone mapping, bloom, FXAA, dynamic resolution with supersampling, particles, sprites, fonts and an immediate-mode HUD. Split screen, including an upside-down half for face-to-face play.
- Touch-first input: early-firing swipes, taps, floating joystick, buttons, look pad, gamepad and keyboard. Plus haptics, synthesised sound effects and music, physics (ray casts, terrain, character controller), ECS, deterministic RNG and noise.
- 4D and higher: N-dimensional vectors, rotations in any plane, polytopes and projection to 3D. The Engine Lab shows 4D–6D shapes.
- Performance: highest display refresh rate, ADPF hint sessions, device tiers, thermal and Game Mode awareness, optional FPS overlay.
- GPU context loss and game exceptions are handled without crashing the launcher.

**Multiplayer: only the two requested methods**
- *Wi-Fi / hotspot*: automatic discovery (UDP broadcast on every interface plus mDNS), TCP for reliable data, UDP for fast data with TCP fallback. If discovery is blocked, players can scan a Wi-Fi QR or type the address.
- *Online*: WebRTC data channels connected by exchanging an invite and a reply code. Codes are `OEA-` + Base32 with a CRC and can be shared as QR, copied, shared, pasted, scanned with the camera or read from a screenshot. Every failure has a clear error message, the connection status is always shown, and "New invite" retries. Connections recover from Wi-Fi ↔ mobile switches without new codes.
- No accounts and no servers. STUN/TURN is used only if the user adds their own; CI rejects any hardcoded public STUN server. "Check online readiness" explains what this phone's network allows.
- Lobbies with ready states, host settings, kick, rejoin, clock sync and relaying through the host. A host can mix Wi-Fi and online players.

**Games**
- **Runner** (Subway Surfers style): seeded endless rail yard with trains, ramps, hurdles, barriers, coins and power-ups. Play a split-screen duel on one phone, take turns, or race over Wi-Fi/online with ghost runners and live standings.
- **Arena** (Free Fire style foundation): skydive, loot, weapons, armour, medkits and a shrinking zone, against bots or friends. Host-authoritative networking with client prediction, interpolation and lag-compensated hits.
- **Chess**: full rules (verified with perft), 10 AI levels, 3D and 2D boards, clocks, hints, takebacks, draw offers, pass & play, Wi-Fi/online, PGN export.

**Dynamic Island**
- Games publish live activities and events to the card, the camera island, or both. With both styles on, each game can be set to automatic, card, camera island or both.
- On Home the island shows the running game with Resume. Inside games it shows game events, calls and music.

**App and CI**
- OEA Games has its own icon and task and can be added to Home. It is also linked from OEA Settings.
- CI now runs 24 engine/game unit tests and checks the engine files exist.
- Permissions added by the engine: Internet, network/Wi-Fi state, multicast and vibration. Camera was already declared.

**Not tested on a device.** Everything builds and passes the unit tests in CI.

---

## Earlier fixes in this PR

**Launcher warning** – the full-screen error only appears if Home never started; a late refresh error with a working Home is logged instead of shown.

**Game Boost** – the floating button stays up during gameplay and loading (no longer ends the session on a stale UsageStats guess or a brief Play Games/ads screen; stops a per-second scan of all apps). The last colour now really cycles as a rainbow. A tidy down/up network-speed readout sits under the button (optional), with a labelled strip in the panel.

**Built-in apps** – Game Boost, Phone, Call Blocker, OEA Settings and the new Freezer app can be added to Home from the drawer even when they're in the OEA folder. There's also OEA Settings › Add OEA apps to Home.

**Freezer** – now its own app with an icon. Polished screen. Freezing shows a progress screen instead of flashing Settings pages. It no longer asks for OEA Assistant again when access is already granted but Android paused the service.

**Phone** – new full-screen (over the wallpaper), popup and floating-card call screens, and you can switch between them during a call. Mute and speaker/Bluetooth go through Telecom. Adds the proximity sensor and an incoming-call notification with Answer/Decline. **Fixes silent incoming calls**: the manifest said OEA plays the ringtone, but it didn't.

**Dynamic Island** – adds a second style: an expandable island under the camera. You can use the card, the island or both, and assign apps to each. Both now expand over Home instead of squeezing the grid.

**Widgets** – drag them between pages like icons. Resize with Android-style handles, kept within each widget's own min/max size.

**Split screen** – the second app now waits until the first is really in front, Android confirms the split, and it recovers once if the split didn't take.

**Hidden apps** – a proper space where hidden apps open and run, with an optional PIN.

items.title: [telemetry] run 39124371684 build log
items.body:
Live build telemetry for [run 39124371684](https://github.com/cheng343/android_device_oneplus_giulia-AERA/actions/runs/39124371684).

Why this exists: runs #5, #7 and #9 all reached ~47 minutes into the build step
and then the runner disappeared, and GitHub **discards the whole job log** when a
runner is lost, so those failures left no evidence at all. This thread is the only
channel that survives, so the build log and the resource state are pushed here
every 30 seconds.

Safe to delete once the run is done.
